# DEVVY UI

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for this repository's structure, component contracts and
verification rules. For additions, customization and source updates, read
[the DEVVY UI skill](../.agents/skills/devvy-ui/SKILL.md) and only the relevant reference.

Edit canonical source, regenerate registry/build output, preserve native accessible behavior
and optional Glass styling, and verify public exports when they change. Use pnpm and the
versions declared in manifests. Keep public API changes, docs and Changesets aligned.
Report checks actually run; an implementation request does not authorize publishing.

Maintain shared rules in AGENTS.md; keep this adapter short.
